definitions.explanation: A brush for painting pictures. Also stands for painting itself in set phrases.

examples.japanese: {絵筆|えふで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧。
⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{絵筆|えふで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I took up the brush again for the first time in ages.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{八十|はちじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{絵筆|えふで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手放|てばな}さなかった→手放す：05338_tebanasu⟧。
examples.english: Even past eighty, my grandfather never put down his brush.

notes:
⟦{筆|ふで}→筆：03601_fude⟧ alone usually means a writing brush; {絵筆|えふで} is the painter's brush.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {絵筆|えふで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take up the brush, to start painting
- {絵筆|えふで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧: to paint (often of a painter at work)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{絵|え}の{具|ぐ}→絵の具：16182_enogu⟧: paints
- ⟦パレット→パレット：33230_paretto⟧: palette
